Counted mature episodes split by entry ISO week at the calendar midpoint between the first and last counted entry weeks (empty weeks included); the middle week of an odd span is in the first half. One split serves the selection board halves and the bench bar's same-sign test.
A memo binds a fill only if finished before that market's regular cash close (local exchange time, DST-aware), not UTC midnight. A market without a close entry opens nothing.

bench_seals.rule: trend_not_falling is a filter challenger. It keeps a primary entry when the entry's 6-month channel direction (ch126_direction, channel_v0, computed at the signal session from closes on or before that session) is rising or sideways. An entry whose direction is falling, or that has no 6-month channel, is not kept. It opens no episode and is scored under the section 8 bench rules: 48 counted mature episodes, a mean difference above 2.5 standard errors, the same sign in both halves, and a capital-days return not below the primary's.
bench_seals.evidence: US rehearsal, descriptive: falling-channel entries had a lower fair-cost median in both windows (L689). Not a US rehearsal test.
